business_problem: BBVA wanted to improve customer service, give retail and business managers AI-based support, and raise employee productivity by embedding generative AI into digital channels and internal work processes.
solution_summary: BBVA describes a multi-front AI implementation that combines customer-facing generative AI with employee productivity tooling. For customers, the bank feeds Blue with customer financial context plus its catalog of products, services and banking transactions so the assistant can answer natural-language questions, return personalized financial information with empathy, and execute selected account and card actions in BBVA's digital channels. The same language-model pattern is being extended to retail and business managers as an AI support layer for faster query resolution and more tailored guidance. Internally, BBVA signed an agreement with OpenAI to deploy ChatGPT Enterprise across the group, with a Global AI Adoption area handling access and an AI Factory developing and scaling use cases. The source does not name a separate storage stack, but it clearly shows AI embedded in both employee workflows and customer service surfaces.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides generative AI assistance to BBVA employees for internal productivity use cases across the bank.

solution_components.name: Blue
solution_components.role: Acts as BBVA's generative-AI virtual assistant, answering natural-language banking questions and handling selected account and card transactions.

data_flow: Customer financial data and BBVA's catalog of products, services and banking transactions are used by Blue to generate natural-language answers, personalized financial information, and selected account or card actions in the bank's digital channels. Separately, BBVA distributes ChatGPT Enterprise to employees through its Global AI Adoption area for internal use cases that the Data area's AI Factory helps develop and scale.
integration_points: BBVA's catalog of products, services and banking transactions
business_outcome: BBVA reports better customer interaction through a more conversational virtual assistant, AI support for managers serving retail and business clients, and measurable employee time savings from ChatGPT Enterprise adoption.
